source.selection_rule: Newest selected attempt, including errors; never select by score.

submission:
k_A_adsorption = 0.92284447015141269
k_B_adsorption = 0.54285135007717022
k_A_desorption = 0.21678809341492888
k_B_desorption = 0.26807923344407619
k_product = 0.98989438962101917
A_adsorption_rate = k_A_adsorption*a_concentration
B_adsorption_rate = k_B_adsorption*b_concentration
A_state_denominator = laplace_rate+k_A_desorption+B_adsorption_rate
B_state_denominator = laplace_rate+k_B_desorption+A_adsorption_rate
AB_state_denominator = laplace_rate+k_A_desorption+k_B_desorption+k_product
AB_per_empty_factor = (B_adsorption_rate*A_adsorption_rate/A_state_denominator+A_adsorption_rate*B_adsorption_rate/B_state_denominator)/(AB_state_denominator-B_adsorption_rate*k_B_desorption/A_state_denominator-A_adsorption_rate*k_A_desorption/B_state_denominator)
A_per_empty_factor = (A_adsorption_rate+k_B_desorption*AB_per_empty_factor)/A_state_denominator
B_per_empty_factor = (B_adsorption_rate+k_A_desorption*AB_per_empty_factor)/B_state_denominator
laplace_empty_fraction = laplace_rate/(laplace_rate+A_adsorption_rate+B_adsorption_rate-k_A_desorption*A_per_empty_factor-k_B_desorption*B_per_empty_factor-k_product*AB_per_empty_factor)
laplace_A_occupied_fraction = A_per_empty_factor*laplace_empty_fraction
laplace_B_occupied_fraction = B_per_empty_factor*laplace_empty_fraction
laplace_AB_complex_fraction = AB_per_empty_factor*laplace_empty_fraction
response = k_product*laplace_AB_complex_fraction
